title: AI Gateway Bedrock streaming passthrough: AWS event-stream exception frames raise HTTPException with a mapped status, not a plain SSE error
answers: Why does a streaming Claude response from Bedrock through the gateway come back as binary garbage instead of SSE?
Why does a mid-stream throttling error on Bedrock reach the client with a 429 status in the SSE error chunk?
Where is Bedrock InvokeModelWithResponseStream converted to Anthropic server-sent events?
What happens when botocore is not installed and a Bedrock Claude stream is requested?
body:
Path: Streaming Anthropic Messages passthrough responses from Bedrock InvokeModelWithResponseStream go through _event_stream_to_anthropic_sse in mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py, which decodes AWS binary event-stream frames and re-emits them as SSE for Anthropic clients and for the gateway's usage and trace parsing.
Rule: Decode each frame with botocore's EventStreamBuffer. For a chunk frame, base64-decode the payload and emit `event: <type>\ndata: <json>\n\n`. For any non-event frame, raise HTTPException with the status from _BEDROCK_STREAM_EXCEPTION_STATUS: throttlingException 429, serviceUnavailableException 503, modelTimeoutException 408, anything else 502. This matches how send_stream_request reports errors before the first frame, so safe_stream writes the status into the SSE error chunk.
Symptom: Bedrock streams use the AWS event-stream binary framing rather than SSE, so a client reading the passthrough stream could not parse the raw response. A mid-stream throttle or unavailable error had to keep its retryable status, or clients would not back off or retry correctly.
Constraints: botocore is imported inside the function. If it is missing, an ImportError with a pip install boto3 hint is raised. The exception-status mapping covers only the three listed exception types; others become 502. Confidence is moderate on the exact client-visible effect of the binary stream, since the PR states the format but not a bug report.
applies: Bedrock streaming for the Anthropic Messages passthrough in the AI Gateway; does not cover the non-streaming path or the Titan/Jurassic/Converse stream handling.
says: Streaming Claude responses from Bedrock through the gateway come back as binary garbage instead of SSE
Mid-stream throttling error from Bedrock shows a 429 status in the streamed error event
Bedrock Claude streaming through the gateway fails when botocore is not installed
search: AI Gateway Bedrock streaming passthrough for Anthropic Messages: decodes AWS binary event-stream frames into Anthropic SSE, and maps mid-stream exception frames to HTTP status codes (throttling 429, unavailable 503, timeout 408, others 502) so retryable errors keep their status. botocore is imported lazily, raising an ImportError with a pip install hint if missing; does not cover the non-streaming path or Titan, Jurassic, or Converse streams.
